claims.text: title: Together AI tags: provider, lab, cloud-platform, us, inference, fine-tuning, open-weight, pricing, api, token-cost, timeline, agentic # Together AI ## Overview Together AI is a San Francisco-based AI cloud platform founded in June 2022 by Stanford researchers and serial entrepreneurs.

The company provides inference, fine-tuning, and training infrastructure for 200+ open-source foundation models , positioning itself as a cost- and speed-optimized alternative to hyperscaler clouds (AWS, Azure, GCP).
As of mid-2026, Together AI has raised $533.5M+, achieved ~$1B annualized revenue (Feb 2026), and serves 450,000+ developers.
The founding team includes CEO Vipul Ved Prakash (two exits to Apple and Proofpoint), CTO Ce Zhang (ETH Zurich), and Chief Scientist Tri Dao (creator of [[meta-llama]]-used FlashAttention).
